title: Cool but shy
body: It’s minimalistic I get it, but guys, no dark themed widget? Widget so basic? Please step it up, I just paid for lifetime access
author: RRRbarca17

title: Better widget and Apple Watch app/widget
body: An amazing app but I would love to have the widget to show only the next unfinished habit which means once I finish the first habit in the list, the widget needs to show the next unfinished one. Also, I would love to have it on my Apple Watch.
author: Sukhrob K
